caption: The video showcases a glowing orange-red bulbous object fixed at the left of a pure black frame, its surface marked by vertical ridges and a bright rim. From its right side a luminous white-to-yellow flame plume jets horizontally outward, fading to orange-red at its tips. Throughout the clip the bulb itself holds its position and stripe pattern while the plume continuously deforms, alternating between short stubby blobs and long stretched, wavy or forked tails. The flame's tip oscillates back and forth as the plume expands and contracts rather than the whole object translating. Small detached ember-like wisps appear and vanish to the right of the main plume in several moments, then fade. Brightness within the plume flickers, with the white-hot core shifting along the horizontal axis. The wavering flame continues to deform through the final moments.
